title: imom34: market intraday momentum (Gao, Han, Li and Zhou 2018, JFE): overnight + first half hour predicts the last half hour
before_registration: Only synthetic self-checks (imom34.py check) and valid-day counts (imom34.py counts, no return read) ran on this design. Prior knowledge: orb15 mom30/mom60 (sign of the first 30/60 min from the main open -> position for the LAST HOUR, M5, net R, no overnight return) REJECTED; SPX mom30 gross -0.146 R dev, -0.033 R 2023+. rescan26 found no gross holder after Holm.
differs_from_orb15: imom34 is the paper's rule, not orb15 mom30: (1) the predictor adds the overnight return (previous session close -> open); (2) the position is held only for the LAST HALF HOUR (orb15 held the last hour); (3) M1 prices at exact clock points instead of M5 bar opens; (4) primary is SPX500 alone, gross bps, no spread rule; (5) the 12th-half-hour predictor and the regression slopes are reported; (6) EUR/USD uses the NY session 08:00-17:00 ET (orb15 used London 08:00-16:00).
declared: Development evidence only. 2023+ is a development window, not a holdout. Binding confirmation for any survivor is prospective (issue 313) or data after 2026-10-07.
data: engine/cache M1 bid/ask npz (history.db candles_ba, newest cache per instrument), cut 2026-10-07T18:30 UTC. Mid = (bid_c + ask_c) / 2.
clock: America/New_York with DST per calendar date. P(T) = mid close of the M1 bar starting at T-1 min.

definitions.r_on: P(open) / P(close of the previous valid session) - 1; previous session at most 5 calendar days back
definitions.r12: P(close-30) / P(close-60) - 1 (the paper's 12th half hour for SPX; the second-to-last half hour elsewhere)
definitions.y: P(close) / P(close-30) - 1, the traded last half hour
definitions.valid_day: Mon-Fri ET; the bars at open-1, open+29, close-61, close-31, close-1 exist; >= 24 of 30 M1 bars in each of the first, second-to-last and last half hour (holidays and half days drop out by missing bars); a previous valid close exists
definitions.gross_bps: s * y * 1e4 (mid entry at close-30, mid exit at close)
definitions.net_bps: long: (bid_c exit - ask_c entry) / mid entry; short: (bid_c entry - ask_c exit) / mid entry; same M1 bars
definitions.R: median |y| in bps over the previous 60 valid days of the instrument (>= 20 days); gross R = gross bps / R

signals.both: sign(r_on + r1) only when sign(r12) agrees, else flat

primary: SPX500/USD, s = sign(r_on + r1), gross mean bps per day with a position. CI from validate.day_boot over all ET weekdays with session bars in the window (block 5, 1000 reps, seed 34).
decision_rule: PASS iff the 95% CI lower bound of the primary gross mean is above 0 in BOTH windows. Otherwise FAIL. One test, no multiplicity adjustment.
secondary: Never decide the verdict: gross R, net bps, hit rate, always-long drift; signals r1, r12, both; OLS slopes of y on (r_on, r1) and on (r_on, r1, r12) with day-block bootstrap CIs; conditioning on |r1| top tercile and on first-half-hour realized volatility (sqrt sum of squared M1 log returns) top tercile, both with tercile edges from the previous 250 valid days (>= 60); WTI, XAU, XAG, NATGAS, EUR/USD with their own sessions; MDE80 = 2.8 x bootstrap SD.
